## 18 Element 18's one route: the customer's view of one processing, served from the read model and from nothing else.

It is a resource of its own and not a filtered projection of the employee's snapshot (D-11-4): the scope that reaches it is fulfillment-customer, the payload carries no assignee and no issue, and the handler holds no write model, so the read path cannot drift into the aggregate (http.no-write-model-in-read). No ownership check is made — the order carries no customer identity to compare against, and the mapping is out of scope (register D13, element 18 Q-18-2). The scope alone decides who may ask.

Method and path
: `GET` `/processing/{processingId}/state`

Authentication
: `bearer JWT`
